Container.Name: dreamscreen-web
Container.Overview: DreamScreen web control and HomeKit bridge. Image is built locally from /mnt/user/Apps/workspace/dreamscreen-web. Host network is required (device replies on UDP 8888, HomeKit uses mDNS). The HomeKit pairing code is printed in the container log.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Web UI port on the host

Config.Name: HomeKit functions
Config.Description: Comma separated: power,inputs,ambient,modes,scenes,hdr. Empty disables HomeKit.

Config.Name: Retries
Config.Description: Extra attempts when the DreamScreen does not answer a state query (1.5s each)
